zh.title: 瑞安航空突撤出亞速群島停飛六條航線砍40萬座位
zh.summary: 瑞安航空撤出亞速群島停飛6條航線；大幅削減40萬個座位衝擊旅遊業。
body: 根據Simple Flying報導，瑞安航空（Ryanair）突然決定撤出亞速群島（Azores）市場。這項突發的營運調整將直接關閉當地的6條航線，並於市場中削減多達400,000個航班座位。
航線的停飛與400,000個座位的移除，打亂了當地的季節性觀光客流量。這項座位供給的大幅減少，對於高度仰賴定期航班客流的島嶼旅遊業造成了衝擊與干擾。
報導另外指出，瑞安航空的突然撤出對該島嶼群地區的國內生產毛額（GDP）造成約1.5%的影響。6條航線的關閉不僅影響旅遊流量，也對當地的季節性經濟發展產生負面效果。

en.title: Ryanair Abruptly Pulls Out Of Azores, Closing Six Routes And 400,000 Seats
en.summary: Ryanair abruptly pulls out of Azores; six routes closed and 400,000 seasonal seats cut.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying, Ryanair has made an abrupt pullout from the Azores region. The sudden operational withdrawal shutters a total of six routes and removes 400,000 flight seats from the aviation market, significantly altering regional flight availability.

The termination of these air services is unsettling seasonal tourism flows, which are heavily dependent on commercial airline capacity. The route closures represent a substantial drop in available seats for travelers visiting the island region during peak seasonal travel periods.

Furthermore, the article highlights that Ryanair's sudden pullout wiped 1.5% off the island region's gross domestic product (GDP). The removal of 400,000 seats and six routes creates broader economic uncertainty for seasonal business and tourism activity across the islands.
